functional_requirements: Provide a 90-degree L-shaped bracket with a 50 mm x 30 mm x 5 mm horizontal base and a 30 mm x 30 mm x 5 mm vertical arm.
The 5 mm inside-corner fillet provides a smooth stress-relieving transition between the base and vertical arm.
No mounting holes, fastener patterns, or load ratings were specified; they should be omitted unless explicitly requested.
The part is suitable for general-purpose FDM 3D printing.
special_features: Vertical arm MUST be placed at one X-end of the base, with VERTICAL_ARM_THICKNESS_X=5 mm along X, VERTICAL_ARM_WIDTH_Y=30 mm along Y, and VERTICAL_ARM_HEIGHT_Z=30 mm above the base top face so that OVERALL_Z=35 mm.
All features MUST be symmetric about the XZ plane; the base and vertical arm MUST be centered on Y=0.
The 5 mm fillet MUST be applied only to the concave inside corner where the vertical-arm inner face meets the base top face, and it MUST run along the Y axis.
The inside fillet MUST be a concave material-adding radius of INSIDE_FILLET_RADIUS=5 mm, NOT a chamfer, NOT an outer-edge round, and NOT a triangular gusset.
Vertical arm MUST NOT be centered along the base length or placed away from the base end; it MUST share one outer end face with the base at ARM_OUTER_FACE_X=-25 mm.
No mounting holes, lightening cutouts, or additional features MUST be added unless explicitly requested; the bracket MUST remain a plain L-profile with only the specified inside fillet.

functional_requirements: Provide a 90-degree L-shaped bracket with a 50 mm x 30 mm x 5 mm horizontal base and a 30 mm x 30 mm x 5 mm vertical arm.
The 5 mm inside-corner fillet provides a smooth stress-relieving transition between the base and vertical arm.
No mounting holes, fastener patterns, or load ratings were specified; they should be omitted unless explicitly requested.
The part is suitable for general-purpose FDM 3D printing.
special_features: Vertical arm MUST be placed at one X-end of the base, with VERTICAL_ARM_THICKNESS_X=5 mm along X, VERTICAL_ARM_WIDTH_Y=30 mm along Y, and VERTICAL_ARM_HEIGHT_Z=30 mm above the base top face so that OVERALL_Z=35 mm.
All features MUST be symmetric about the XZ plane; the base and vertical arm MUST be centered on Y=0.
The 5 mm fillet MUST be applied only to the concave inside corner where the vertical-arm inner face meets the base top face, and it MUST run along the Y axis.
The inside fillet MUST be a concave material-adding radius of INSIDE_FILLET_RADIUS=5 mm, NOT a chamfer, NOT an outer-edge round, and NOT a triangular gusset.
Vertical arm MUST NOT be centered along the base length or placed away from the base end; it MUST share one outer end face with the base at ARM_OUTER_FACE_X=-25 mm.
No mounting holes, lightening cutouts, or additional features MUST be added unless explicitly requested; the bracket MUST remain a plain L-profile with only the specified inside fillet.
